verdict.rationale: Docs describe both prebuilt connectors for shopping carts, billing systems, ERPs, and accounting platforms (docs-1, docs-16) and explicit API-based backfill methods — sync full-year history via API (docs-3, docs-19), CSV file upload for backfilling (docs-22), and a migration guide with transaction mapping when switching from Avalara/TaxJar (docs-7, docs-21) — collectively covering multi-channel import for complete filing coverage.  Missing for 10: no named list of specific connector platforms, no independent/hands-on confirmation that connector syncs work reliably in practice, and no evidence on how conflicting/duplicate transactions across channels are reconciled.
